title: Bazaar
summary: A segmented marketplace: an edge API with an SSRF link-preview bridges into an internal-only mesh. SSRF -> mock metadata (service token) -> internal order API -> customer PII. The SSRF sink and internal hostnames are only in the SPA bundle.

loot.description: the SPA bundle names the SSRF sink and the internal service hosts
internal service token handed out by the metadata mock (via SSRF)
customer orders + PII behind the internal order API
